English: Soil organic matter (SOM) is a key component of forest productivity and soil organic carbon stock.
Luganda: Ebiramu by’omu ttaka (SOM) kye kimu ku bibeera mu ttaka ekikulu wamu n’ebiramu ebibeera mu ttaka ebirimu carbon.

Zulu: I-Soil organic matter (SOM) iyingxenye ebalulekile yokukhiqiza kwehlathi kanye nesitokwe sekhabhoni ye-organic emhlabathini.
Hausa: Ƙwayoyin halitta na ƙasa (SOM) mahimmin sashi ne na yawan amfanin gandun daji da kuma ƙwayar kabon ta ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Manyora a tlhago a mobu (SOM) ke karolo ye bohlokwa ya tšweletšo ya ka dithokgweng le tšweletšo ya khapone ya tlhago.
Amharic: የአፈር ኦርጋኒክ ጉዳይ (SOM) የደን ምርታማነት እና የአፈር ኦርጋኒክ የካርቦን ክምችት ዋና አካል ነው።

English: However, little is known about SOM and C variability in miombo woodlands which is a significant ecosystem in sub-Sahara African forests and vital for REDD+ strategies.
Luganda: Wabula, kitono ekimanyiddwa ku SOM n’enjawulo ya C mu bibira bya miombo ate nga kitundu kyabiramu mu bibira by’omu kitundu kya Afirika y’omu Sahara ate nga bikulu nnyo mu REDD+ strategies.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀, ìmọ̀ díẹ̀ ni ó wà nípa SOM àti ìyípadà C ní ìgbó ilẹ̀ onígi miombo, èyí tí ó jẹ́ agbègbè ohun abẹ̀mí tí ó ṣe pàtàkì ní apá gúsù Sahara igbó Africa àti èyí tí ó ṣe pàtàkì fún àwọn ìlànà REDD+
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, kuncane okwaziwayo mayelana nokuhlukahluka kwe-SOM no-C emahlathini e-miombo okuyindawo ebalulekile yemvelo emahlathini ase-sub-Sahara ase-Afrika futhi ebalulekile kumasu e-REDD+.
Hausa: Duk da haka, kaɗan aka sani game da bambancin SOM da C a cikin gandun daji na miombo wanda shi ne muhimmin yanayin halitta a cikin dazuzzukan Afirka kudu da saharar kuma yana da mahimmanci ga dabarun REDD+.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, go tsebja gannyane ka ga SOM le go farlogana ga C ka mefelong a mehlare a miombo e lego Lefelo le bohlokwa la phadišano ya diphedi ka dithokgweng tša ka dinageng tša borwa bja Afrika ebile di bohlokwa ka go maano a REDD+.

English: In this study, nine edaphic factors were measured and used to analyse the variability of SOM in miombo woodland sites with different tree structures in Luanshya, Zambia.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, ensonga ezeekwanya ku ttaka mwenda zaatunuulirwa era ne zikozesebwa okwekenneenya obusobosi bwa SOM mu bibira by’omu miombo omuli emiti egy’enjawulo mu Luanshya, Zambiya.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, okùnfà ẹdafíkì ní a gbé lé òṣùwọ̀n tí a sì lò láti ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ ìyípadà SOM ní àwọn ìgbó ilẹ̀ onígi miombo pẹ̀lú onírúurú ààtì igi ní Luanshya, Zambia.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, izici eziyisishiyagalolunye ze-edaphic zalinganiswa futhi zasetshenziswa ukuhlaziya ukuhlukahluka kwe-SOM ezindaweni zasehlathini le-miombo ezinezakhiwo ezihlukene zezihlahla e-Luanshya, e-Zambia.
Hausa: A cikin binciken, an auna abubuwan yanayi na ƙasa yake haifarwa guda tara kuma an yi amfani da su don nazarin bambancin SOM a cikin gandun daji na miombo tare da tsarin bishiyoyi daban-daban a Luanshya, ta ƙasa Zambiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše mabaka a seemo sa mobu a senyane a ile a elwa le go šomišwa go sekaseka go farologana ga SOM la mafelong a mehlare a miombo ao a nago le sebopego seo se fapafapanego sa mehlare ka Luanshya, Zambia.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ፣ ዘጠኝ የአፈር ነክ ምክንያቶች ተለክተው የSOMን ተለዋዋጭነት ለመተንተን በሉአንሺያ፣ ዛምቢያ ውስጥ የተለያዩ የዛፍ አወቃቀሮች ባላቸው የሚኦምቦ ደን ቦታዎች ላይ ጥቅም ላይ ውለዋል።

English: These SOM values at different depths also varied between miombo woodland sites of different successional stages, notably that areas affected by recent tree clearance had higher than average SOM content per layer (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).
Luganda: Emiwendo gya SOM ku buwanvu obw’enjawulo gyayawuka mu bifo by’ebibira bya miombo eby’enjawulo eby’emitendera egiddiŋŋana egy’enjawulo, kwe kugamba nti ebifo ebyakosebwa n’okutemwamu emiti mu kiseera eky’amabegako gyalina ekigero kya SOM kitono ku buli mutendera gwa ttaka (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).
Yoruba: Iyì àwọn SOM ní onírúurú jínjìn náà yàtọ̀ láàárín àwọn ìgbó ilẹ̀ onígi miombo, ní onírúurú ìpele ní tẹ̀léǹtẹ̀lé, ní ìfiyèsí pé àwọn ibi tí igi gíge ti wáyé láìpẹ́ jọjọ ní tayọ ìdajì SOM lórí léyà kọ̀ọ̀kan(0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).
Zulu: Lawa manani e-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukene nawo ahluka phakathi kwezindawo zehlathi le-miombo zezigaba ezihlukene ezilandelanayo, ikakhulukazi ukuthi izindawo ezithinteke ekususweni kwezihlahla kwakamuva zibe nenani eliphakeme kunokuqukethwe okumaphakathi kwe-SOM isendlalelo ngasinye (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).
Hausa: Hakan nan waɗannan darajojin SOM a zurfi daban-daban kuma sun bambanta a tsakanin ɓangarorin gandun daji na miombo na matakai daban-daban, musamman cewa yankunan da yanke bishiyoyi ya shafa kwanan nan sun sami mafi girma fiye da matsakaicin abun ciki na SOM a kowane shimfiɗa (0-10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).
Northern Sotho: Boleng bjo bja SOM ka go ya fase fao go fapafapanego le gona go ile gwa fapana magareng ga mafelo a mehlare a miombo a dikgato tše di fapafapanego tša go latelana, go tloga go le nyanyeng gore mafelo ao a amilwe ke go rengwa ga mehlare fao go sa tšogo dirwa fao go bilego le palogare ya godimo go feta ka fao go lekanego ga diteng tša SOM ka llaga (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).
Amharic: በተለያየ ጥልቀት ላይ ያሉት እነዚህ የSOM ልኬቶች በተለያዩ ተከታታይ ደረጃዎች በሚያምቦ የደን ቦታዎች መካከል ይለያያሉ፣ በተለይም በቅርብ ጊዜ የዛፍ መቁረጥ የተጎዱ አካባቢዎች በአንድ ንብርብር ከአማካይ የ SOM ይዘት ከፍ ያለ (0-10 ሴሜ፥ 5.57%፥ 10-20 ሴሜ፥ 4.20%፤ 20-30 ሴሜ፥ 4.30%)።

English: Canonical correspondence analysis (CCA) revealed that the most significant environmental factors influencing SOM were woodland thinning by clearance, and silt content within soils.
Luganda: Canonical correspondence analysis (CCA) yalaga nti ensonga nnabitondu ezisinga okuba ez’amaanyi ezikosa SOM kwe kukendeera kw’emiti egitemwa, n’olusenyu mu ttaka.
Yoruba: Ọgbọ́n ìṣàtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmọ́ ìbádọ́gba ìṣe elétò (CCA) fihàn pé okùnfà ajẹmọ́-àdúgbò tí ó ń nípa lórí SOM jẹ́ ìmú tín-ín-rin ìgbó ilẹ̀ onígi nípasẹ igi gíge àti àkoónú sílíìtì láàrín ilẹ̀ erùpẹ̀.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziywa kwezincwadi zeCanonical (CCA) kwembula ukuthi izici ezibaluleke kakhulu zemvelo ezithonya i-SOM ukucekelwa phansi kwehlathi ngokususwa, kanye nodaka oluphakathi kwenhlabathi.
Hausa: Binciken halittu da muhallinsu (CCA) ya bayyana cewa mafi mahimmancin abubuwan muhalli da suke tasiri a kan SOM su ne rage yawan gandun daji ta hanyar sharewa, da kuma abubuwan cikin ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya kamano ya khanonikhale (CCA) e utollotše gore mabaka a bohlokwa kudu a tikologo ao a huetšago SOM e bile go sesefatša ga dithokgwa tša mehlare ka go e rema, le diteng tša megogolwa ka gare ga mabu.
Amharic: ቀኖናዊ የጥምረት ትንተና (ሲሲኤ) በ SOM ላይ ተጽዕኖ የሚያሳድሩ በጣም ጉልህ የአካባቢ ሁኔታዎች የእንጨት መሬት በጠራራ መቀነስ፣ እና በአፈር ውስጥ ያለው የደለል ይዘት ናቸው።

English: This study highlights that CCA can be used to show the relative importance of different forest successional stages as a function of management practices, as well as edaphic factors, in determining miombo soil SOM content.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kutangaaza bulungi nti CCA asobola okukozesebwa okulaga omugaso gw’emitendera gy’ebibira ebiddiriŋŋana ng’omulimu gw’ebikolebwa mu nzirukanya, wamu n'ensonga ezeekwanya ku ttaka, mu kugera ebibeera mu ttaka ebya mu SOM mu miombo.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí ṣe àlàyé pé a le è ṣe àmúlò CCA láti ṣe àfihàn pàtàkì onírúurú ìpele igbó ní tẹ̀léǹtẹ̀lé gẹ́gẹ́ bí iṣẹ́ àwọn ìṣe ìṣàkóso, pẹ̀lú okùnfà ẹdafíkì, ní sísọ àkoónú SOM ilẹ̀ miombo.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lugqamisa ukuthi i-CCA ingasetshenziswa ukukhombisa ukubaluleka okuhlobene kwezigaba ezihlukene zokulandelana kwehlathi njengomsebenzi wezinqubo zokuphatha, kanye nezici ze-edaphic, ekunqumeni okuqukethwe kwe-SOM yenhlabathi ye-miombo.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya nuna cewa za a iya amfani da CCA don nuna mahimmancin matakan dazuzzuka daban-daban a matsayin aikin gudanar da ayyukan gudanarwa, da kuma abubuwan da yanayi na ƙasa yake haifarwa, wajen ƙayyade abun SOM na ƙasar miombo.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di laetša gore CCA e ka šomišwa go laetša gore bohlokwa dikgato tše di latelanago tša sethokgwa bjalo ka mošomo wa diitro tša ba taolo, gammogo le seemo sa mobu, e le go tseba diteng tša SOM sa seemo sa mobu wa miombo.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት CCA የሚያምቦ አፈር SOM ይዘትን ለመወሰን የተለያዩ የደን ተከታታይ ደረጃዎችን እንደ የአስተዳደር ልማዶች፣ እና እንደ አፈር ነክ ምክንያቶችን፣ አንጻራዊ ጠቀሜታ ለማሳየት ጥቅም ላይ ሊውል እንደሚችል አጉልቶ ያሳያል።

English: The results of this study are particularly relevant for addressing current REDD+ reforestation and management strategies that are aimed at increasing carbon stocks in the tropical forests of sub-Saharan Africa.
Luganda: Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno byekwanya bulungi mu kukola ku kuzzaawo ebibira okwa REDD+ n’obukodyo bw’enzirukanya obugenderera okuzzaawo carbon mu bibira by’omu mu Afirika esangibwa mu ddungu Sahara.
Yoruba: Èsì iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí ṣe pàtàkì ní pàtó ní ṣiṣe REDD+ ìsọdigbógànpadà àti ọgbọ́n abọsí-àkókò ìsàkóso èyí tí ó fojúsun ìmúgbèrú kábọ́ọ̀nù ọ̀gáníìkì ní àwọn igbó ilẹ̀ olóoru ní gúúsù Sahara Africa.
Zulu: Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ibaluleke kakhulu ekubhekaneni namasu amanje okutshalwa kabusha kwamahlathi e-REDD+ okuhloswe ngawo ukukhulisa isitokwe sekhabhoni emahlathini ashisayo ase-sub-Saharan Africa.
Hausa: Sakamakon wannan binciken yana da mahimmanci musamman don magance yanayin sake shuka bishiyoyi na REDD+ na yanzu da kuma dabarun gudanarwa waɗanda suke da nufin haɓaka kayan kabon a cikin dazuzzuka na wurare masu zafi na yankin Afirka kudu da Sahara.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša dinyakišišo tše di tloga di le maleba go rarolla maano a bjale a go bjala mehlare ga REDD+ le maano a taolo ao a ikemišeditšego go oketša tšweletšo ya khapone ka dithokgweng tša throphikhale tša borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ውጤት በተለይ ከሰሃራ በታች ባሉ የአፍሪካ ሞቃታማ ደኖች ውስጥ ያለውን የካርቦን ክምችት ለመጨመር የታቀዱ የREDD+ ደን መልሶ ማልማት እና የአስተዳደር ስልቶችን ለመፍታት ጠቃሚ ነው።

Luganda: Emiti gitemebwe n’obwegendereza olw’okulongoosa ettaka, bwe batyo bannassaayansi abanoonyereza ku bibira by’omu Zambia.

English: Researchers say cleared forest areas and topsoils in a forest in Zambia had more organic matter, which means better quality soil.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti ebitundu ebyali byatemwamu ebibira n’okuggyibwako ettaka ery’okungulu mu kibira mu Zambia mwalimu ebiramu bingiko, ekitegeeza nti ettaka eryo lyali lyamutindo mulungiko.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé, àwọn agbègbè igbo tí ó mọ́ àti àwọn ilè òkè ní igbó Zambia ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníìkì púpọ̀, èyí tí ó túmọ̀ sí ilẹ̀ tí ó ní ọ̀rá.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ezigawuliwe zamahlathi kanye nenhlabathi engaphezulu ehlathini laseZambia kunezinto eziphilayo eziningi, okusho ukuthi inhlabathi esezingeni eliphakeme.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce wuraren dazuzzuka da aka share da kuma saman ƙasa a cikin wani daji a Zambiya suna da ƙarin ƙwayoyin halitta, wanda yake nufin ƙasa mai inganci.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore mafelo a dithokgwa ao mehlare ya gona e remilwego ka Zambia a be a na le manyora a tlhago, go rago mobu wa boleng bjo bokaone.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በዛምቢያ ውስጥ የተመነጠሩ በደን የተሸፈኑ የደን ቦታዎች እና የላይ አፈሮች የበለጠ ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ እንደነበራቸው ይናገራሉ፣ ይህም ማለት የተሻለ ጥራት ያለው አፈር ነው።

English: It is important to understand soil quality in sub-Saharan Africa since it has a big impact on how well plants and trees are able to thrive.
Luganda: Kikulu nnyo okutegeera nti omutindo gw’ettaka mu Afirika esangibwa mu ddungu Sahara kubanga kyalina okukosa kunene ku ngeri ebimera n’emiti gye bikulamu.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe pàtàkì láti ní òye bí ilẹ̀ ṣe dára sí ní gúúsù Sahara Africa bí ó ti jẹ́ pé ó jẹ́ ohun tí ó kó ipa ribiribi lórí bí igi àti àwọn ewéko ṣe máa gbóri.
Zulu: Kubalulekile ukuqonda ikhwalithi yenhlabathi e-sub-Saharan Africa njengoba inomthelela omkhulu ekutheni izitshalo nezihlahla zikwazi kanjani ukuchuma.
Hausa: Yana da mahimmanci a fahimci ingancin ƙasa a yankin Afirka kudu da Sahara tun da yana da babban tasiri a kan yadda tsirrai da bishiyoyi suke iya bunƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Go bohlokwa go kwešiša boleng bja mobu ka borwa bja Afrika ka ge bon a le seabe se segolo mabapi le ka fao dimela le mehlare di kgonago go phela.
Amharic: ከሰሃራ በታች ባሉ የአፍሪካ አካባቢዎች የአፈርን ጥራትን መረዳት በጣም አስፈላጊ ነው ምክንያቱም እጽዋት እና ዛፎች ምን ያህል በደንብ እንዲበለጽጉ ትልቅ ተጽእኖ አለው።

English: Soil has different nutrients, and organic matter and carbon are the most important to help plants thrive.
Luganda: Ettaka lirina ebirungo byanjawulo, era ebiramu ebibeeramu wamu ne kaboni bye bisinga okuyamba ebimera okukula.
Yoruba: Erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀ ní oníruurú ohun amúlẹ̀jípépé, bẹ́ẹ̀ ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì pẹ̀lú kábọ́ọ̀nù ṣe pàtàkì jùlọ sí ìmúgbèrú àwọn ewéko.
Zulu: Umhlabathi unemisoco ehlukene, kanti izinto eziphilayo kanye nekhabhoni yikona okubaluleke kakhulu ukusiza izitshalo zichume.
Hausa: Ƙasa tana da sinadirai daban-daban, kuma ƙwayoyin halitta da kabon su ne mafi mahimmanci don taimakawa tsirrai su girma.
Northern Sotho: Mobu o na le dijo tše di fapafapanego, gomme manyora a tlhago a mobu le khapone di bohlokwa kudu go thuša gore dimela di phele.
Amharic: አፈር የተለያዩ ንጥረ ነገሮች አሉት፣ እና ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ እና ካርቦን እጽዋት እንዲበለጽጉ በጣም አስፈላጊ ናቸው።

English: Organic matter are compounds in soil that come from the remains of dead plants and animals.
Luganda: Ebiramu kimu ku bibeera mu ttaka ebiva mu bimera n’ensolo ebifa.
Yoruba: Àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì jẹ́ èròjà nínú erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀ tí ó wá láti ara àwọn ewékò àti ẹranko tí wọ́n ti kú.
Zulu: Izinto eziphilayo ziyinhlanganisela enhlabathini evela ezinsalela zezitshalo nezilwane ezifile.
Hausa: Ƙwayoyin halitta mahaɗi ne a cikin ƙasa waɗanda suke fitowa daga ragowar matattun tsirrai da kuma dabbobi.
Northern Sotho: Manyora a tlhago ke ditsekana tša ka gare ga mobu tšeo di tšwago go mašaledi a dimela le diphoofolo tše di hwilego.
Amharic: ኦርጋኒክ ቁሶች በአፈር ውስጥ ከሞቱ ዕፅዋትና እንስሳት ቅሪት የሚመጡ ውህዶች ናቸው።

English: Over half (58%) of organic matter is just carbon, and the rest is water and other nutrients.
Luganda: Ebitundu ebisukka mu makkati (58%) g’ebiramu abeera kaboni, era ebisigadde gabeera mazzi n’ebirungo ebirala.
Yoruba: Ìdá tí ó ju ìdajì lọ (58%) nínú àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì jẹ́ kábọ́ọ̀nù lásán nígbàtí àwọn nǹkan ìyókù jẹ́ omi àti àwọn ohun amúlẹ̀jípépé mìíràn.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwengxenye (58%) ye-organic matter yikhabhoni nje, kanti enye ingamanzi nezinye imisoco.
Hausa: Sama da rabin (58%) na ƙwayoyin halitta kabon ne kawai, sauran kuma ruwa ne da sauran abubuwan gina jiki.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ya go feta seripagare (58%) sa manyora a tlhago ke khapone, gomme ye e šetšego ke meetse le dijo tše dingwe.
Amharic: ከግማሽ በላይ (58%) የኦርጋኒክ ቁስ አካል ካርቦን ብቻ ነው፣ የተቀረው ውሃ እና ሌሎች ንጥረ ነገሮች ናቸው።

English: Soil with more organic matter, and carbon therefore, keeps water for longer and has more other nutrients.
Luganda: Ettaka eririmu ebiramu ebisingako, wamu ne carbon, libeeramu amazzi okumala ebbanga ddeneko ate era libeeramu n’ebirungo ebirala bingi.
Yoruba: Erùpẹ̀ Ilẹ̀ tí ó ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì púpọ̀, àti kábọ́ọ̀nù a máa gba omi sára fún ìgbà pípẹ́, ó sì tún ni àwọn ohun amúlẹ̀jípépé mìíràn.
Zulu: Umhlabathi onezinto eziphilayo eziningi, kanye nekhabhoni, ngakho-ke, ugcina amanzi isikhathi eside futhi unezinye imisoco.
Hausa: Saboda haka, ƙasa tare da ƙarin ƙwayoyin halitta, da kuma kabon, tana kiyaye ruwa na tsawon lokaci kuma tana da ƙarin sauran abubuwan gina jiki.
Northern Sotho: Mobu wo o nago le manyora a tlhago a mantši, le khapone ka fao, o kgona go swara meetse lebaka le letelele ebile o na le dijo tše dingwe go ona.
Amharic: ብዙ ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ ያለው አፈር፣ እና ካርቦን ስለዚህ፣ ውሃን ለረጅም ጊዜ ያቆያል እና ሌሎች ተጨማሪ ንጥረ ነገሮች አሉት።

English: Scientists do not know much about changes in organic matter and carbon in sub-Saharan African soils, even though they are so important for the growth of plants and trees.
Luganda: Bannasaayansi tebalina bingi bye bamanyi ku nkyukakyuka mu biramu ne kaboni mu ttaka lya Afirika esangibwa mu ddungu Sahara, newankubadde nga bya mugaso nnyo eri okukula kw’ebirime n’emiti.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì kò ní ìmọ̀ púpọ̀ nípa àwọn àyípadà àwọn àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì àti kábọ́ọ̀nù ní erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀ gúsù Sahara ti Africa, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé wọ́n ṣe pàtàkì fún ìdàgbàsókè àwọn ewéko àti igi.
Zulu: Ososayensi abazi okuningi mayelana nezinguquko zezinto eziphilayo kanye nekhabhoni enhlabathini yase-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara, nakuba zibaluleke kakhulu ekukhuleni kwezitshalo nezihlahla.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya ba su da masaniya sosai game da sauye-sauyen ƙwayoyin halitta da kabon a cikin ƙasar Afirka kudu da Sahara, duk da cewa suna da mahimmanci ga ci gaban tsirrai da kuma bishiyoyi.
Northern Sotho: Bašomi ba tša mahlale ga ba tsebe kudu ka ga diphetogo tša manyora a tlhago le ka ga khapone ka go mebu ya borwa bja Afrika, le ge e le gore e bohlokwa go kgolo ta dimela le mehlare.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች ከሰሃራ በታች ባሉ የአፍሪካ አፈሮች ውስጥ በኦርጋኒክ ቁስ እና በካርቦን ላይ ስላለው ለውጥ ብዙም አያውቁም፣ ምንም እንኳን ለእጽዋት እና ለዛፎች እድገት በጣም ጠቃሚ ናቸው።

English: In this study, the researchers wanted to find out how soil organic matter in a forest changed, and what determines the amounts.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula engeri ebiramu by’omu ttaka mu kibira gye bakyukamu, era na kiki ekisalawo omuwendo.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwadìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ láti mọ bí ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀ ní igbó ṣe máa ń yípadà, àti ohun tí ó máa ń ṣe okùnfa bí ó ti tó.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuthola ukuthi umhlabathi wezinto eziphilayo ehlathini washintsha kanjani, nokuthi yini enquma amanani.
Hausa: A cikin binciken, masu binciken sun so su gano yadda ƙwayoyin halitta na ƙasa a cikin gandun daji suka canza, da abin da yake ƙayyade adadin.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba ka ga ka fao manyora a tlhago a mobu ka sethokgweng a fetogilego ka gona, le gore ke eng seo se dirago ditekano tša manyora ao.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ ተመራማሪዎቹ በደን ውስጥ ያለው የአፈር ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ እንዴት እንደተለወጠ፣ እና መጠኑን ምን እንደሚወስነው ለማወቅ ፈልገዋል።

English: They did their study in a forest in Zambia.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwabwe baakukolera mu kibira ky’e Zambia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn ní igbó Zambia.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwabo balwenzela ehlathini lase Zambia.
Hausa: Sun yi bincikensu ne a wani daji a ƙasar Zambiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile dinyakišišo tša bona ka sethokgweng sa ka Zambia.
Amharic: በዛምቢያ ጫካ ውስጥ ጥናታቸውን አድርገዋል።

English: They collected soil samples at the top (0-10 cm), middle (10-20 cm), and deep (20-30 cm) levels, and in different areas of the forest.
Luganda: Baakuŋŋaanya sampolo z’ettaka ku mitendera esatu, erya waggulu (0-10 cm, erya wakati (10-20 cm), n’erya wansi (20-30 cm), era ne mu bitundu eby’enjawulo eby’ekibira.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gba àpẹẹrẹ erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀ ní ìpele òkè (0-10 cm), àárín (10-20 cm), àti ìsàlẹ̀ (20-30 cm), àti ní onírúurú agbègbè káàkiri igbó náà.
Zulu: Baqoqa amasampula enhlabathi phezulu (0-10 cm), maphakathi (10-20 cm), futhi ajulile (20-30 cm) amazinga, nasezindaweni ezahlukene zehlathi.
Hausa: Sun tattara samfurorin ƙasa a matakan saman (0-10 cm), tsakiyar (10-20 cm), da zurfin (20-30 cm), kuma a wurare daban-daban na gandun daji.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba kgoboketša disampole tša mobu wa ka godimo (0-10 cm), wa gare (10-20 cm), wa ka fase (20-30 cm), le ka mafelong ao a fapafaoanego a sethokgwa seo.
Amharic: ከላይ (0-10 ሴሜ)፣ መካከለኛ (10-20 ሴሜ)፣ እና ጥልቀት (20-30 ሴሜ) ደረጃዎች፣ እና በተለያዩ የጫካ ቦታዎች ላይ የአፈር ናሙናዎችን ሰብስበዋል።

English: The researchers then tested the soils in a laboratory to check how much organic matter it contained.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza olwo ne bakebera ettaka mu ggezeserezo okukebera ebiramu ebirimu.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí wá ṣe àyẹ̀wò àwọn erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀ wọ̀nyí ní yàrá ìṣèwádìí sáyẹńsì láti wo iye àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì tí ó wà nínú ilẹ̀ náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babe sebehlola inhlabathi elabhorethri ukuze bahlole ukuthi iqukethe izinto eziphilayo ezingakanani.
Hausa: Daga nan ne masu binciken suka gwada ƙasa a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje don duba adadin ƙwayoyin halittar da suke cikinsa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši go tloga fao ba ile ba dira diteko tša mobu woo ka laporathoring go lekola gore o na le manyora a tlhago a makae.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በመቀጠል ምን ያህል ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ እንደያዘ ለማወቅ በላብራቶሪ ውስጥ ያሉትን አፈሮች ፈተሹ።

English: A laboratory is a building where scientists do the tests and experiments, often using precision equipment to measure specific parameters.
Luganda: Eggezeserezo kye kizimbe bannassaayansi we bakolera okugezesa, okusinga nga bakozesa ebyuma ebituukira ddala okupima ebigero ebirambike.
Yoruba: Yàrá ìṣèwádìí sáyẹńsì jẹ́ ilé, ní ibi tí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ti máa ń ṣe onírúurú àyẹ̀wò àti ìdánwò, tí wọ́n sì máa ń ṣe àmúlò irúfẹ́ àwọn irinṣẹ́ kan ní pàtó láti ṣe òdiwọn àbùdá àmúṣòdiwọ̀n kan pàtó.
Zulu: Ilabhorethri ibhilidi lapho ososayensi benza khona izivivinyo nezivivinyo, ngokuvamile basebenzisa okokusebenza okunembayo ukukala amapharamitha athile.
Hausa: Ɗakin gwaje-gwaje gini ne inda masana kimiyya suke yin gwaje-gwaje, galibi suna amfani da ingantattun kayan aiki don auna takamaiman sigogi.
Northern Sotho: Laporathori ke moago woo go wona bašomi ba tša mahlale ba dirago diteko le ditekolo go ona, gantši ba šomiša setlabelo sa go lekola ka tsinkelo go ela mathoko a itšego.
Amharic: ላቦራቶሪ ሳይንቲስቶች ፍተሻዎችን እና ሙከራዎችን የሚያደርጉበት ሕንፃ ነው፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ የተወሰኑ መለኪያዎችን ለመለካት ትክክለኛ መሳሪያዎችን ይጠቀማሉ።

English: They also recorded other properties of the soil like its type, for instance sandy or clay-like.
Luganda: Era baawandiika n’ebintu ebirala ebikwata ku ttaka nga ekika kyalo, okugeza lya lusenyu oba bbumba.
Yoruba: Wọn tún ṣe àgbàsílẹ̀ àwọn àkòónú erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀ mìíràn bíi irúfẹ́ rẹ̀, fún àpẹẹrẹ bíi ilẹ̀ oníyanrìn tàbí ilẹ̀ alámọ̀.
Zulu: Baphinde baqopha ezinye izici zenhlabathi njengohlobo lwayo, isibonelo njengesihlabathi noma njengobumba.
Hausa: Sun kuma rubuta wasu kadarorin ƙasa kamar nau’inta, misali yashi ko yumɓu.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba ngwala gape pego ya ditsekana tše itšego tša mobu go swana le mohuta wa mobu, go fa mohlala wa santa goba wa letsopa.
Amharic: እንዲሁም እንደ ለምሳሌ አሸዋማ ወይም ሸክላ መሰል ያሉ፣ ሌሎች የአፈር ባህሪያትን መዝግበዋል።

English: Their results showed that the amount of organic matter was very different between different places, and at different depths.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu byalaga nti omuwendo gw’ebiramu ebirimu gwali gwa njawulo nnyo okusinziira mu bifo eby’enjawulo n’obuwanvu obw’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Èsì wọn fihàn pé iye àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì yàtọ̀ gbáa láàárín onírúurú ibi, àti bí ó ti jìn sí.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo yabonisa ukuthi inani lezinto eziphilayo lalihluke kakhulu phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukahlukene, futhi ekujuleni okuhlukene.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa adadin ƙwayoyin halitta ya bambanta sosai a tsakanin wurare daban-daban, kuma a zurfi daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laeditše gore tekano ya manyora a tlhago e be e fapane kudu magareng ga mafelo ao a fapanego, le ka go ya fase fao go fapanego.
Amharic: ውጤታቸው እንደሚያሳየው የኦርጋኒክ ቁስ መጠን በተለያዩ ቦታዎች እና በተለያየ ጥልቀት መካከል በጣም የተለያየ ነው።

English: Topsoil had the highest organic matter of up to 114 milligrams (mg) in a hectare, followed by deep soil (almost 100 mg per hectare).
Luganda: Ettaka ery’okungulu lye lyali lisingamu ebiramu ebingi nga biwera mirigulaamu 114 mu buli hekiteya, ne kuddako ettaka erya wansi ddala (nga liweramu nga mirigulaamu 100 mu buli hekiteya).
Yoruba: Ilẹ̀ òkè ní ó ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì tí ó pọ̀ jùlọ, èyí tí ó tó 114 milígramù (mg) in ẹkítà kan, ní ìgbàtí ilẹ̀ tí ó jì si tẹ̀lé èyí pẹ̀lú ( ohun tí ó fẹ́rẹ̀ tó 100mg ni ẹkítà ilè kan).
Zulu: Inhlabathi engaphezulu yayine-organic matter ephezulu kakhulu efika ku-114 milligrams (mg) ehektheleni, ilandelwa yinhlabathi ejulile (cishe i-100 mg ihektha ngalinye).
Hausa: Ƙasar saman tana da mafi girman al’amuran halitta har zuwa milligrams 114 (MG) a cikin kadada ɗaya, sannan ƙasa mai zurfi (kusan 100 MG a kowace kadada).
Northern Sotho: Mobu wa ka godimo o bile le manyora a tkhago a mantši go fihla go dimilikramo tše 114 (mg) ka gare ga hekthara, gwa latela mohu wa ka fase (tekano ya go nyaka go ba 100 mg ka hekthara).
Amharic: የላይኛው አፈር በአንድ ሄክታር ውስጥ እስከ 114 ሚሊግራም (ሚግ) የሚደርስ ከፍተኛው ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ ነበረው፣ ከዚያም ጥልቅ አፈር (በሄክታር 100 ሚሊ ግራም ማለት ይቻላል) ይከተላል።

English: Middle soil had the lowest amount of up to 80 mg per hectare.
Luganda: Ettaka eryawakati lye lyali lisingamu ebigero ebyawansi ebiwera mirigulaamu 80 mu buli heekiteeya.
Yoruba: Ilẹ̀ àárín ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì tirẹ̀ lọlẹ̀ jùlọ, èyí ni 80mg ní ẹkítà ilẹ̀ kan.
Zulu: Umhlabathi ophakathi wawunenani eliphansi kakhulu elingafika ku-80 mg ihektha ngalinye.
Hausa: Ƙasar tsakiya tana da mafi ƙarancin adadin har zuwa 80 MG a kowace kadada.
Northern Sotho: Mobu wa gare o bile le tekano ya afsefase ya go fihla go 80 mg ka hekthara.
Amharic: መካከለኛው አፈር በሄክታር እስከ 80 ሚግ ዝቅተኛው መጠን ነበረው።

English: The researchers said places in the forest that were recently cleared had more organic matter than uncleared areas.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebitundu mu bibira ebyali byakatemebwamu emiti bye byali bisingamu ebiramu ku ebyo ebyali tebinnatemwamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé àwọn ibi tí wọhn ṣe pamọ́ nínú igbó ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì ju àwọn ibi tí wọn kò pamọ́ lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ezisehlathini ezisanda kugawulwa zinezinto eziphilayo eziningi kunezindawo ezingacacile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce wurare a cikin dajin da aka share kwanan nan suna da ƙwayoyin halitta fiye da wuraren da ba a share ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore mafelo a ka sethokgweng ao a sa tšwago go rengwa mehlare a be a na le manyora a tlhago a mantši go feta mafelo ao a sego a rengwa mehlare.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በጫካ ውስጥ በቅርብ ጊዜ የተጸዱ ቦታዎች ግልጽ ካልሆኑ ቦታዎች የበለጠ ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ አላቸው ብለዋል።

English: They suggest that cutting trees in a forest, with careful management, could therefore increase soil organic matter.
Luganda: Baateesa nti okutema emiti mu kibina, bwe kiba nga kikoleddwa bulungi, kisobola okwongera ku muwendo gw’ebiramu ebibeera mu ttaka.
Yoruba: Wọn gbà á ni ìyàjú pé gígé igi nínú igbó pẹ̀lú ìsàkósò tí ó tọ̀nà, le è mú àǹfàní bá àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀.
Zulu: Basikisela ukuthi ukusika izihlahla ehlathini, ngokuphathwa ngokucophelela, kungandisa i-organic matter.
Hausa: Suna bayar da shawarar cewa yanke bishiyoyi a cikin dazuzzuka, tare da kulawa da hankali, zai iya ƙara ƙwayoyin halittar ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišinya gore go rema mehlare ka sethokgweng, ka taolo ye e nago le šedi, ka fao go ka oketša manyora a tlhago a mobu.
Amharic: በጫካ ውስጥ ዛፎችን መቁረጥ፣ ጥንቃቄ ያለው አያያዝ፣ የአፈርን ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ እንደሚጨምር ይጠቁማሉ።

English: The researchers also observed that soil colour changed from dark brown (topsoil) to yellowish brown (deep soil), and that sandy and clay soils had more organic matter.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, abanoonyereza beetegereza nti langi y’ettaka yakyukanga okuva ku kitaka omukwafu (ettaka eryawaggulu) ne lifuuka lya kyenvuyenvu omuli kitaka (ettaka eryawansi ddala), nti ate ettaka ery’olusenvu n’olubumba lye lyali lisinga okubaamu ebiramu.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí tún ṣe àkíyèsí peh àwọ erùpẹ̀ ilẹ̀ máa ń yípadà sí búráùn tó dúdú (ilẹ̀ òkè) sí aláwọ̀ búráùn tí ó jẹ mọ́ yẹ́lò (ilẹ̀ ìsàlẹ̀) àti pé ilẹ̀ iyanrìn àti alámọ̀ ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì jùlọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde babona ukuthi umbala wenhlabathi ushintshile usuka kunsundu ngokumnyama (inhlabathi engaphezulu) waba nsundu ngokuphuzi (inhlabathi ejulile), nokuthi inhlabathi enesihlabathi nobumba yayinezinto eziningi eziphilayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma lura cewa launin ƙasa ya canza daga launin ruwan ƙasa mai duhu (saman ƙasa) zuwa launin ruwan ƙasa mai launin rawaya (ƙasa mai zurfi), kuma ƙasa mai yashi da yumɓu tana da ƙarin ƙwayoyin halitta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši gape ba lemogile gore mmala wa mobu o fetogile go tloga go mmalwa o motsooto wa go tiba (mobu wa ka godimo) go ya go mmala o serolane (mobu wa ka fase), le gore mebu ya santa le ya letsopa e bile le manyora a tlhago a mantši.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የአፈር ቀለም ከጥቁር ቡናማ (የላይኛው አፈር) ወደ ቢጫ-ቡናማ (ጥልቅ አፈር) መቀየሩን እና አሸዋማ እና የሸክላ አፈር የበለጠ ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ እንደነበራቸው ተመልክተዋል።

English: Areas in the forest that were more exposed to sunlight had bigger and older trees, and more organic matter.
Luganda: Ettaka ly’omu kibira eryali lisinga okutuukibwako omusana lye lyali lirina emiti eminene era emikuluko, n’ebiramu ebisingako obungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn agbègbè ní inú igbó tí wọ́n rí òrùn jùlọ ní igi tí ó tóbi tí ó sì dàgbà, àti pé wọ́n tún ní àkoónú ọ̀gáníkì tí ó pọ̀.
Zulu: Izindawo ezisehlathini ezazichayeke kakhulu ekukhanyeni kwelanga zazinezihlahla ezinkulu nezindala, kanye nezinto eziphilayo.
Hausa: Wuraren dajin da suka fi fuskantar hasken rana suna da manya da tsofaffin bishiyoyi, da kuma ƙarin ƙwayoyin halitta.
Northern Sotho: Mafelo a ka sethekgweng ao a bego a fihlelelwa kudu ke seetša sa letšatši a bile le mehlare ye megolo ya kgale, le manyora a tlhago a mantši.
Amharic: በጫካ ውስጥ ለፀሀይ ብርሀን የበለጠ የተጋለጡ ቦታዎች ትላልቅ እና አሮጌ ዛፎች እና የበለጠ ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ ነበሯቸው።

English: The researchers, who were based in Zambia and South Africa, said their methods could be adapted by others to assess soil quality in different places and at different depths.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abaali basinziira mu Zambia ne South Afirika baagamba nti enkola zaabwe zaali zisobola okukozesebwa abantu abalala okwekebejja omutindo gw’ettaka mu bifo eby’enjawulo n’obuwanvu obw’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí, èyí tí wọ́n wà ní Zambia àti South Africa, sọ pé àwọn olùwádìí mìíràn le è ṣe àmúlò ìlànà àwọn láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò bí ilẹ̀ ṣe dára sí ní onírúurú ibi àti ní ìwọ̀n jínjìn tí ó wù wọ́n.
Zulu: Abacwaningi abazinze eZambia naseNingizimu Afrika, bathe izindlela zabo zingashintshwa ngabanye ukuze kuhlolwe izinga lomhlabathi ezindaweni ezahlukene nasekujuleni okuhlukene.
Hausa: Masu binciken, waɗanda suke zaune a ƙasashen Zambiya da Afirka ta Kudu, sun ce wasu za su iya daidaita hanyoyinsu domin tantance ingancin ƙasa a wurare daban-daban da kuma mabambantan zurfi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši, bao ba bego ba le ka Zambia le ka Afrika Borwa, ba boletše gore mekgwa ya bona e ka fetošwa ke banyakišiši ba bangwe go lekola boleng bja mafelo ao a fapafapanego ka go ya fase ga mobu fao go fapafapanego.
Amharic: በዛምቢያ እና በደቡብ አፍሪካ የተቀመጡት ተመራማሪዎቹ፣ የተለያዩ ቦታዎች እና የተለያየ ጥልቀት ያላቸውን ቦታዎች የአፈር ጥራት ለመገምገም ዘዴዎቻቸው በሌሎች ሊላመዱ እንደሚችሉ ተናግረዋል።
